title: Baked Cashew Chicken
reject_reason: Chicken with broccoli, peppers, cashews in a soy/hoisin sauce over rice is the same cashew-chicken dinner as live thai-cashew-chicken (shares cashews, peppers, soy, rice); baked-vs-stir-fry method does not make a distinct plate.
